$comment: The minter resolves __VALID_ENVELOPE_SIG__ to the p256-tagged signature form `p256.<86-char-b64url>` (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.3) because the sender AID is a P-256 AID (kat-keypair-005-p256, known-answer/keypairs.json) — ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 over the envelope signing input, JOSE raw R||S encoding. A verifier that only implements Ed25519 fails this fixture; dual-algorithm verification is mandatory in v0.2 (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.3).
description: Envelope verification happy path with a P-256 sender. The sender's AID uses the v0.2 algorithm-tagged form `aid:pubkey:p256:<44-char>` (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.3) and the envelope signature uses the algorithm-tagged wire form `p256.<sig>` (§5.4.3). Timestamp is within the tolerance window relative to the pinned reference clock, the message_id is fresh, and the signature verifies under the sender's P-256 key. Expected: success.

expected.rationale: Envelope is fresh, structurally valid, and the p256-tagged signature verifies under the P-256 key encoded in the sender AID.
